title: DAG CRUD operations & graph traversal
description: Implement Go handlers for creating, reading, updating, and deleting nodes and edges. Implement graph traversal algorithms: modified DFS for linearization, topological sort for dependency ordering, and reachability queries. Support querying 'all ancestors' and 'all descendants' of a node. Used by the Linearizer and Thread system.

title: Node-to-Query translation
description: When a writer types or locks a bullet point (e.g., 'The Hero's Motivation'), translate that text into a search query for the hybrid index. Handle both explicit keywords and semantic intent. May involve query expansion or rephrasing via LLM to improve recall. Returns ranked chunk candidates.

title: Epic: DAG Data Model & Go Backend
description: Design and implement the Node-Edge-Thread data model in Go. Nodes are atomic content blocks (UUID, body, metadata, requirements). Edges define relationships (Linear, Branch, Jump) with optional audience conditions. Threads are virtual ordered lists of Node IDs representing audience-specific paths. Includes API scaffolding, DAG CRUD, graph traversal, and cycle/integrity validation.

title: Epic: Semantic Vault - Ingestion Pipeline
description: Audio upload, speaker-diarized transcription, semantic chunking (embedding-distance topic splitting), and hybrid indexing (BM25 + qwen3-embedding). This is the foundational data layer that all retrieval depends on. Raw transcript chunks are immutable once ingested.

title: Graph validation (cycle detection & integrity)
description: Implement validation that runs on every edge insertion to ensure the graph remains acyclic (DAG property). Detect orphan nodes, dangling edge references, and thread references to non-existent nodes. Expose a /validate endpoint and run checks as pre-commit hooks on graph mutations.

title: Hybrid indexing pipeline (BM25 + qwen3-embedding)
description: Index all semantic chunks using dual retrieval: BM25 for exact keyword matching (e.g., character names, technical terms) and qwen3-embedding vectors for semantic similarity. Store BM25 index and vector embeddings. Provide a unified search API that fuses both scores. This index is queried by the Retrieval Engine.

title: Epic: Audience Threads & CYOA Navigation
description: Multi-threaded narrative support: Thread CRUD API, Thread Selector UI with node highlighting/dimming, Thread Brush tool for painting audience paths through the DAG, CYOA Exit Widgets at chapter ends with continuation proposals, and conditional edge logic for audience-based routing (e.g., expert vs novice).

title: Semantic chunking engine
description: Implement topic-shift-based chunking rather than fixed-size splitting. Use embedding distance between consecutive sentences to detect topic boundaries. When the cosine distance between adjacent sentence embeddings exceeds a threshold, insert a chunk boundary. Each chunk gets a UUID, speaker label, timestamp range, and raw text. Chunks are immutable once created.

title: Epic: Outline Interaction System
description: The core authoring experience: free-text bullet entry, ambient Ghost Proposals (light grey RAG suggestions), lock/reject interactions with visual state transitions (dashed→solid, source badges), drag-and-drop sibling reordering, and Smart Parenting that flags semantically out-of-context moves.

title: Epic: React UI Foundation
description: React project setup and the core Three-Pane Workspace: Source Vault (left, Audio Ribbon heatmap), Living Outline (center, editing workspace), and Evidence Drawer (right, chunk highlighting). Uses dnd-kit for tree interactions. Communicates with Go backend via REST/WebSocket API.

title: Design Node-Edge-Thread schema
description: Define the core data model. Nodes: UUID, body (transcript chunks + glue), metadata labels (Expert-only, Foundation, Technical Detail), optional requirement list (node IDs that must be read first). Edges: source/target node IDs, type enum (Linear, Branch, Jump), optional condition (e.g., audience==novice). Threads: ID, name, ordered list of node IDs representing a reading path. Design Go structs and database schema (likely SQLite or Postgres).

title: Hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval with score fusion
description: Implement the core retrieval pipeline: given a query, run BM25 and qwen3-embedding searches in parallel, fuse scores using reciprocal rank fusion or weighted combination, and return the top-K chunks. Tunable weights between lexical and semantic scoring. This is the heart of the RAG system.

title: Epic: Retrieval Engine (RAG)
description: The proposal engine: translate outline node text into search queries, run hybrid BM25+vector retrieval against the Semantic Vault index, cluster retrieved chunks into sub-themes via LLM, and track chunk usage to prevent redundant proposals. This powers the Ghost Proposal system.

title: Epic: Version Control System
description: Writing-aware version control: outline snapshot/save system with optional labels, visual diffs showing which subtrees were added/removed/unlocked with rescue capability, and outline branching for trying alternate story directions with side-by-side comparison.

title: Audio upload & transcription interface
description: Build the audio upload endpoint (Go) and React upload component. Accept common audio formats (mp3, wav, m4a). Integrate with a transcription service that supports speaker diarization so the system knows who is talking. Store raw transcription with speaker labels and timestamps. This is the entry point for all content.

title: Go backend API scaffolding
description: Set up the Go project structure: HTTP router (chi or gin), middleware (CORS, logging, auth placeholder), database connection pool, and configuration management. Define REST API routes for nodes, edges, threads, chunks, and search. Establish the project layout (cmd/, internal/, pkg/, api/). This is the foundation all backend features build on.

title: Epic: Synthesis & Linearization Engine
description: Transform the DAG into readable output: constrained stitching prompts that add minimal AI glue between original chunks, a Linearizer that traverses the graph per-thread using modified DFS, a live Stitching View UI, a Glue Toggle slider (0-100% AI transitions), and export to Markdown/PDF with hyperlink anchors.
